message.reasoning_content:
We need to refine the initial plan (context-aware stacking meta-learner) into structured JSON, using historical experience. Key learnings from history:

Successful: coupon×occupation and coupon×distance TE keys; heterogeneous MLP+GBDT blend; joint blend+threshold search; CatBoost native categoricals.

Failed: multi-seed OOF with median (variance but didn't improve; slow), extra TE expansion risky, coupon-centered features + gating (0.7576 baseline was that, then failed).

Current baseline 0.7532. Initial plan is context-aware stacker on OOF. Historical: stacking with coupon interactions plausible but risk of overfit; must be lightweight, well regularized, and logit space. Also resource constraints 600s.

Refine: implement stacker but keep minimal feature set (logits of deep & tree, difference, coupon one-hot, few context features), use strong L2, inner CV over few C values, use existing OOF from a single seed to save time. Also perhaps add coupon×occupation TE key? Initial plan says keep FE unchanged. But historical success says TE keys worked. However plan says KEEP UNCHANGED FeatureEngineer. Deviating may be fine if refining, but instruction says stay true to direction. I can add a small enhancement to FE: expose the OOF-encoded context features needed for the stacker meta matrix without changing base features — i.e., add a helper method to extract compact context features. That's a module touch on data_processing for stacker feature retrieval. That's reasonable and stays in direction (stacker uses these compact context features from fitted FE).

So modules: model_design (stacker class), training_evaluation (OOF stacker fitting, threshold search, persistence, predict), data_processing_and_feature_engineering (expose context feature extraction, ensure picklable).

Let me draft.

Also avoid multi-seed (failed/slow) — use single seed OOF. Keep fold count 5. Use LogisticRegression from sklearn (available since StratifiedKFold used). Ensure stacker is persisted in meta.pkl.

Predict-time: stacker applied to fresh probabilities plus context features from fe.transform.

Interface: preserve meta.pkl keys, add stacker payload; keep blend_weight/threshold for fallback.

Write JSON.
